setup.outage_source: NSA primary-cell T2 (HO+RCH), SIGCOMM'22 artifact, measured events
setup.detect_rule: session declared lost when the oldest unacknowledged message has waited one probe timeout, srtt + max(4 rttvar, 1 ms) + 25 ms (RFC 9002 form, application-acknowledgment RTT samples, Karn); connect and handshake bounded by the same timeout, then retried; unacknowledged messages resent
setup.session_loss: emulator --kill-flows: connections seen before an outage start are dropped from then on
setup.attribution: late messages assigned to the outage whose window [start - 0.5 s, next start - 0.5 s) contains their generation time

x3.contrast: per interruption, late in a cell minus late in lost C0 on the same interruption (same seed and index); mean over the interruptions valid in both cells; 95 % CI from a paired two-stage bootstrap (runs, then interruptions, 10,000 replicates); also over all interruptions, and a t-interval over the five run means

qc.rule: a window is invalid if the emulator delivered a frame more than stall_ms late (testbed/x3_qc.py)

constants.pto_ms: RTT + 25 + 1 + 0.5 (margin, variation floor, host turnaround per sample)
constants.phase: g0 uniform on [-OWD, 16 - OWD); records generated before the onset were delivered, only their acknowledgments were lost
